validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and independently corroborated — this is Saudi Aramco's Haradh–Hawiyah Free Flow Pipelines Project (part of the $4.5B Dec-2017 Haradh & Hawiyah gas megaproject contract round, EPC China Petroleum Pipelines). Not a hallucination. CLASSIFICATION: correctly recorded — onshore dry-gas transmission/free-flow trunk line carrying gas from Haradh field to the Hawiyah Gas Plant. DUPLICATE: no clean duplicate in the 65-row roster. P1917/1918/1919 (Haradh Khuff–Hawiyah) are short 43 km / 30 in Khuff-formation feeders — distinct from this 450 km / 36 in / 290 MMcf/d free-flow network; P1905/P1907 are Haradh–Uthmaniya, P1915 is Hawiyah–Uthmniyah — different endpoints. No merge. ATTRIBUTION (the real defect): the name 'Madrakah' and province 'Makkah' are errors. GEM's own wiki page states the pipeline is 'Known as Haradh–Hawiyah' and gives the Arabic name 'خط أنابيب التدفق الحر' (= 'Free Flow Pipeline'). Madrakah is a village in MAKKAH province on the Red Sea side (21.98N, 39.99E, per Wikipedia/Mindat) — ~1,000 km from the Haradh/Hawiyah gas fields, which sit in the EASTERN PROVINCE (Ghawar area). A 450 km pipe cannot run Madrakah→Hawiyah; offshore-technology explicitly states it 'will start in Eastern Province ... and ends in Eastern Province.' So both endpoints are Eastern Province, the source field is Haradh (not Madrakah), and the name should be Haradh–Hawiyah. SPEC: independently verified and AGREEING with GEM — OGJ: '450-km pipeline network ... 290 MMscfd of gas from Haradh field to the Hawiyah gas plant'; offshore-technology: '450km-long', 'maximum diameter of 36 inches', Eastern Province, owned by Saudi Aramco, commences 2024; cost $4.5B (combined contract round). Length 450 km ✓, Capacity 290 MMcf/d ✓, Cost $4.5B ✓, Owner/Operator Saudi Aramco ✓, Status operating ✓, Start 2024 ✓. ConstructionYear 2018 is plausible (contract awarded Dec 2017, target early 2019) but I found no source stating 2018 explicitly — leave as-is, unverified. The current Status ref (attaqa.net) is 404 dead; OGJ + offshore-technology substitute as live status/spec refs.
